text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What... is this voice? Could it be... a 
beckoning from the Three Goddesses...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To think there are words you feel you must 
impart to me...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall listen. To your 
history, and everything you have 
inherited...
